title: Facing the Rancor
subtitle: The Journey of Grogu
description: As Boba Fett's pet Rancor wreaks havoc across the streets of Mos Espa, the Mandalorian hands Grogu to Peli Motto for safety. But the young one knows what must be done. He breaks free and uses his increased abilities in the Force to calm the raging beast. Unfortunately, that puts them both down for a much-needed nap.
